applications.name: Mercy
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker avoids a Hit with the Dexterity Mastery, they gain a Mercy Passive. Executing a Well-Timed Block will remove all Mercy Passives from the Attacker and apply them to the Defender, where they will fall off 1 at a time every 1.50 seconds. The Defender reduces damage taken from all sources by 90% unless they have a Mercy Passive. If the Defender has a Mercy Passive, the Attacker gains +80% Attack Rating for their Special Attacks.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker avoids a Hit with the Dexterity Mastery, they gain a Mercy Passive. Executing a Well-Timed Block will remove all Mercy Passives from the Attacker and apply them to the Defender, where they will fall off 1 at a time every {2} seconds. The Defender reduces damage taken from all sources by {1}% unless they have a Mercy Passive. If the Defender has a Mercy Passive, the Attacker gains +{0}% Attack Rating for their Special Attacks.

applications.name: Mutagenic Acceleration - 1
applications.description: Mutant Attackers increase their Offensive [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k], up to [16982bff]20%[-], every time they fill a Bar of Power or trigger a Regeneration Buff or Passive effect. Tech Attackers gain up to [16982bff]20%[-] increased Special Attack Damage based on their Armor Rating.
applications.rawDescription: Mutant Attackers increase their Offensive [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k], up to [16982bff]{1}%[-], every time they fill a Bar of Power or trigger a Regeneration Buff or Passive effect. Tech Attackers gain up to [16982bff]{0}%[-] increased Special Attack Damage based on their Armor Rating.

applications.name: Mercy
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker avoids a Hit with the Dexterity Mastery, they gain a Mercy Passive. Executing a Well-Timed Block will remove all Mercy Passives from the Attacker and apply them to the Defender, where they will fall off 1 at a time every 1.50 seconds. The Defender reduces damage taken from all sources by 90% unless they have a Mercy Passive. If the Defender has a Mercy Passive, the Attacker gains +80% Attack Rating for their Special Attacks.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker avoids a Hit with the Dexterity Mastery, they gain a Mercy Passive. Executing a Well-Timed Block will remove all Mercy Passives from the Attacker and apply them to the Defender, where they will fall off 1 at a time every {2} seconds. The Defender reduces damage taken from all sources by {1}% unless they have a Mercy Passive. If the Defender has a Mercy Passive, the Attacker gains +{0}% Attack Rating for their Special Attacks.

applications.name: Mutagenic Acceleration - 1
applications.description: Mutant Attackers increase their Offensive [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k], up to [16982bff]20%[-], every time they fill a Bar of Power or trigger a Regeneration Buff or Passive effect. Tech Attackers gain up to [16982bff]20%[-] increased Special Attack Damage based on their Armor Rating.
applications.rawDescription: Mutant Attackers increase their Offensive [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k], up to [16982bff]{1}%[-], every time they fill a Bar of Power or trigger a Regeneration Buff or Passive effect. Tech Attackers gain up to [16982bff]{0}%[-] increased Special Attack Damage based on their Armor Rating.

applications.name: Bubble Shield - 3
applications.description: Each time the Attacker Blocks an attack, they are inflicted with an indefinite Bubble Shield Passive, reducing their Block Proficiency by 6%. Every 10 stacks makes the Defender's next attack Passively [k=glossary/unblockable]Unblockable[/k].
applications.rawDescription: Each time the Attacker Blocks an attack, they are inflicted with an indefinite Bubble Shield Passive, reducing their Block Proficiency by {1}%. Every {2} stacks makes the Defender's next attack Passively [k=glossary/unblockable]Unblockable[/k].
